explanation: Probe whether reserved write-identity conflicts can poison or bypass the ledger. First submit same run_id/request_id/tool with altered authorized content (restricted repo, then changed body). These should not create or overwrite the reserved operation. Then submit the exact reserved report once. A failure is only if either conflicting request succeeds with 200, or the later exact request / continuation loses legitimate completion or returns the wrong stored issue. Rejection of the conflicting requests alone is expected and not claimed as a bug.
